text:
anya: Quick follow-up to the RFC: we've observed cost under-attribution when traces are sampled head-only and requests get proxied across shards. Need a tiny handshake to carry budget metadata across sampling and proxies.

devon: Minimal shape? envelope header + tiny span deltas to avoid index bloat.

anya: Proposal: envelope field `origin_budget` (string decimal) + optional per-span `consumed` (string). Edge ingress writes origin_budget once (first-writer wins). Spans report consumed when work is done; cache-hits omit consumed and cache-fills emit an async span with consumed>0. Sampler invariant: if origin_budget present, sampled root MUST include it.

marcos: Aggregator reconcile: reconciled_cost = min(origin_budget, sum(consumed)). If no consumed present, fall back to route-model estimate and tag confidence.

sue: Rollout plan: ingest opt-in per-region/tenant. Phase 0 collectors accept but ignore for billing; Phase 1 staging validation; Phase 2 small-prod cohort; add kill-switch.

obs-bot: Created OBS-1012 for tests + RFC addendum.

anya: I'll draft the addendum (schema + sampler invariant + aggregator pseudo-query + test matrix) and open sampler PR.
